tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade nursing examinations

steps.what: Compile examinations by selecting validated nursing questions and checking coverage
Administer the examination and handle learner access and assessment exceptions
Grade examination responses and approve the exact results

tasks.design: Configure native item-bank selection and examination assembly in {LMS}. The instructor verifies content and coverage, administers the assessment and retains all grading and result decisions; this proposal does not assume that clinical reasoning can be machine-marked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assembling a valid examination repeats item-search and layout work.
tasks.enabler_now: Assessment systems support item banks and administration without requiring a model.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical validity, item exposure and defensible judgement on reasoning responses.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising unsafe reasoning and deciding what the evidence establishes about competence.
tasks.altitude: Less routine exam assembly, with unchanged examiner responsibility.

evidence.claim: Ans supports assessment administration, closed-question marking and item statistics; this design claims assembly help, not nursing assessment validity.
The proposed assembly saving is an unmeasured scenario; no physics grading percentage is transferred.

assumptions: Boundary includes instructor exam assembly, administration and grading. Delegation is an alternative allocation, not disappearance of other markers' labour.

The instructor selects blueprint sections, item IDs and versions, weights, duration and allowed aids in s1; its retained21 hours include capture and clinical checks. The assessment coordinator's existing item validation is an upstream contract unchanged by this design; additional bank maintenance is counted below.
Absent or unsuitable validated items are written and reviewed manually in s1; savings require enough reusable items. Existing marking runtime earns no new saving.
Native item-bank configuration precedes custom code; no model judges clinical competence.
research_questions: Does native assembly reduce clerical time after full clinical coverage checks?

approvals.approved_version: Exact examination response set and final results revision; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R91 gives gross9 minus upkeep3 = net6. Low assumes item suitability checks leave only3 hours benefit; high requires30% reduction in the30-hour assembly step. Administration and grading keep full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify current nursing guidance and choose the lecture's concepts and clinical examples
Prepare lecture explanations from the verified guidance and teaching brief

loop.purpose: Draft lecture wording from approved guidance
loop.output: Draft lecture notes with source-linked explanations
loop.check: Instructor checks every clinical statement, contraindication, dose example and qualification against current guidance
loop.stop: Unsupported clinical content or ambiguity returns to manual writing after one correction
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanatory prose needs contextual wording; fixed templates cannot supply it

steps.what: Deliver nursing lectures and answer students' clinical learning questions

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} templates before a bounded source-based drafting loop. The instructor selects and verifies clinical content, checks the complete draft and retains live delivery and questions supported by {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing clear explanations adds effort after clinical source selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can assist wording; no clinical accuracy breakthrough is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Outdated guidance, omitted qualifications and plausible but unsafe examples.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining safe practice and responding to misconceptions.
tasks.altitude: A modest wording benefit is possible; clinical content and teaching remain the instructor's responsibility.

evidence.claim: Source-constrained nursing lecture drafting is a model-knowledge proposal; the digest does not establish its clinical safety or measured time benefit.

assumptions: Boundary includes lecture-specific source review, notes and delivery. Reusable syllabi and handouts are in the course-material task and are not counted twice.

Instructor produces topic, learner level, current sources, permitted clinical examples and required caveats in s1; all25 hours include capture. No patient record or free generated clinical summary is an input.
s2 includes full clinical meaning checks and manual fallback. Native templates come first and live contact time stays unchanged.
research_questions: Do full clinical checks leave a net benefit on pharmacology and mental-health lecture notes?

already_counted.description: Clinical meaning checks and manual corrections

incremental.description: Source and draft-quality checks beyond case preparation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R92.5 gives gross7.5 minus upkeep3 = net4.5. Low assumes clinical checking removes all wording benefit; high requires30% reduction of the25-hour drafting step while source review and delivery remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define syllabus requirements, assignment goals and verified nursing source material
Prepare syllabi, homework assignments and handouts from the verified brief

loop.purpose: Draft educational material wording from verified content
loop.input: Teacher brief, approved outcomes and source excerpts
loop.output: Draft materials with source references and explicit exercise solutions
loop.check: Instructor checks clinical correctness, solvability, workload and outcome coverage against sources
loop.stop: Unsupported clinical advice or unsound exercises return to manual writing after one correction
loop.why_not_simpler: Course-specific explanations and exercises need contextual writing beyond fixed syllabus fields

steps.what: Validate clinical content and approve the exact course materials for use

tasks.design: Fill fixed fields through native {DOCS} templates first, then use a bounded loop for source-based wording. The instructor verifies exercises and clinical content and approves the exact materials for {LMS} use.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reusable documents still need coherent course-specific explanations and assignments.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting can assist composition, with clinical validation retained.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical exceptions and simplified examples that can teach unsafe habits.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing educationally useful problems and safe levels of simplification.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft wording may be possible; clinical and curricular choices remain human.

reach.learn: Safe exercise design and clear learning sequences

evidence.claim: Nursing course-material drafting and the time range are model-knowledge proposals; no task-specific measured result is supplied by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is reusable course documents and assignments. Lecture-specific notes and exam compilation belong to their own tasks; reused source work is assigned once.

Instructor produces outcomes, dates, source versions, workload limits, clinical constraints and exercise requirements in s1; all35 hours include capture and verification. Missing requirements require manual clarification.
Native templates precede a model. Clinical draft checking and manual fallback remain in s2, and final validation keeps all25 hours in s3.
No identifiable patient data is needed for this educational drafting design.
unknowns: Actual composition share and reusable material coverage
research_questions: Does clinical verification leave a net benefit for ordinary syllabi and handouts?

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected material, source versions and course context; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R84 gives gross16 minus upkeep4 = net12. Low assumes clinical corrections remove the entire wording benefit; high needs40% reduction of the40-hour composition step, with source selection and final validation unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Demonstrate patient care in clinical units

steps.what: Demonstrate patient care in clinical units while explaining safe actions to nursing students

tasks.design: Retain bedside demonstration with the instructor and clinical team. Guidance in {DOCS} supports teaching, but no digital substitution reduces patient attention or physical care.
tasks.previous_blocker: Demonstration combines physical care, patient response and teaching in a live clinical setting.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing guidance access supports practice without replacing the demonstration.
tasks.still_hard: Patient dignity, changing condition and explaining actions without distracting from care.
tasks.human_edge: Adapting safely to the patient and showing students when to stop or seek help.
tasks.altitude: No change to clinical teaching time or care responsibility.

evidence.claim: Physical patient-care demonstration remains human work; the digest establishes no replacement or measured saving.

assumptions: Boundary is clinical demonstration, not classroom materials or learner assessment. Patient agreement and clinical suitability are checked within the unchanged bedside activity under local practice.
No model consumes a structured patient-suitability flag and no recording is introduced.
Native guidance access is sufficient; no custom build proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because care and demonstration procedures remain unchanged.
unknowns: Local clinical teaching permissions and scope
Patient suitability and student readiness requirements
research_questions: Which demonstrations need clearer patient and student preparation through existing clinical practice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; net0 after zero upkeep. No physical care, patient attention or demonstration time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Nursing instructors retain clinical and assessment authority; bounded drafting is tested only for clerical composition benefits.
reach: Work with assessment coordinators on item validity and clinical educators on safe examples
role.ambitious_version: Verified teaching materials and efficient examination assembly, with full human control over clinical teaching and competence decisions.
